info.description: AI interior design & real-product sourcing platform
info.title: Renovara API

get.description: Liveness: the process answers (no dependencies checked — a DB outage must not restart the API).
Readiness: database, Redis (when configured) and object storage are reachable.

put.description: Platform assignment (invoice, pilot agreement) — no card payment, no paid period.

get.description: Uploads rejected by the antivirus (kept 30 days for review; never served).

post.description: Records money received outside a payment provider (bank transfer against an invoice). Idempotent by reference.
Platform admin grants a platform-level role (linguist / verifier) to an existing account.

get.description: Connector health history: the last 50 runs and the alert log.

post.description: Queue one background index batch (crawl-delay respected; ~batch × 3 s).

Dry run: find product links and extract up to 5 products — nothing is written to the catalogue.
Shows which method works for this site (JSON-LD / microdata / OpenGraph / HTML) before parsing is enabled.
Approval creates the supplier organisation and its catalogue owner, and invites the contact as supplier admin.

delete.description: A supplier with orders is kept (history, ledger); otherwise it is removed with its catalogue.
Deletion goes through the privacy flow (grace period, then anonymisation) — never a silent hard delete.

post.description: Lost phone: the second factor is removed; enforced roles must enrol again at the next sign-in.

patch.description: Persists the interface language (hy | ru | en) in the user profile.

post.description: Schedules deletion after a grace period (PRIVACY_DELETION_GRACE_DAYS); signing in and cancelling stops it.

get.description: All personal data of the signed-in user (profile, consents, sessions, activity, own projects with files) as ZIP.

post.description: Starts enrolment: a new secret (pending until confirmed), otpauth URI and QR code.
Three-step onboarding: organisation → own role → first project (the client navigates to /app/new).
Always 200 — the response never reveals whether the address is registered.
Free plans switch at once; paid ones start a card payment on the bank's page (the browser is redirected).

get.description: AI spend of the organisation (today / month, by task and provider) against its budget.

post.description:
Commits a supplier price list. Guard: a mass update that changes prices by more
than max_price_change_pct for >20% of rows is rejected (protection from broken feeds).

delete.description: Archived, not erased: existing estimates and albums keep referring to it; catalogue and design skip it.

get.description: External sources available for the «Внешний каталог» switch (no admin details).
The catalogue lists variants (`pv:<id>`); the editor opens the whole product.

post.description:
Client's approval is recorded in the approval journal; the designer finalises it
(the AI and the share link never publish the construction package on their own).

get.description: Non-secret runtime config for the web client.

delete.description: Deletes a project with its files. Refused once an order left the cart: orders and the ledger keep their history.

post.description:
Direct-to-storage upload (S3/MinIO): returns a 15-minute PUT URL into a per-project
quarantine prefix. With local storage the client falls back to multipart upload.
Splits the approved estimate into per-supplier orders of one cart.
Mandatory before ordering: re-reads current prices and availability of every cart item.
Creates a manufacturer order (cart → recheck → request, like any order). Production Ready only.
Sets a verified dimension; optionally rescales the whole plan so that the wall matches.

get.description:
SSE progress stream. The browser's EventSource sends the HttpOnly session cookie;
API clients may use `Authorization: Bearer`. Tokens are never put in the URL.

post.description:
Starts a hosted payment with the contracted provider. Without one → 409 payment.integration_pending
(the UI shows «Integration pending»; nothing is marked paid).
Bureau-side moves: cancel, dispute, close after delivery / installation.

get.description: Pilot validation report (status, inputs with files, flow, assumptions, risks, approvals, history) as JSON or PDF.

post.description: One RFQ per supplier from the current version, after a fresh estimate snapshot.
Specialist (verifier / bureau admin) confirms measurements & engineering — audit record.
Development helper: seeds the synthetic demo apartment as a draft geometry.

put.description: Manual edit (move/rotate/lock/remove). Every save is a new version; rules and estimate are recomputed.

post.description:
«Перепроверить цены и наличие»: refreshes external records (live when enabled), marks stale data,
recomputes the estimate as a new version. Mandatory before RFQ/approval.

get.description: Furnished demo scene for the landing page (synthetic demo project only).

Where the supplier's products are used and who asked for them. Client data (name, address, project title) is not
disclosed: the supplier sees the bureau, city, area and items; contact comes through a request or an order.

post.description: Adds an existing account to the organisation, or creates one and e-mails a link to set the password.
